authorship: Hand-authored vector annotations after visual review of every active source foreground plate. Original bitmap pixels unchanged.

material_channels.water: Liquid horizontal source-pixel ripple; source-safe sampling only.
material_channels.flow: Vertical local source-pixel displacement in painted falls; no UV wrapping.
material_channels.ice: Stationary ice, faint glints; zero source-pixel displacement.

edge_policy: Feather inward by feather_texels and only sample a displaced UV when source and target both remain inside the same material mask. Do not read or stretch a shore, tree, gate or rock into water.

sector07.review: Two conservative industrial pond patches; the orange reflection is liquid water. Trees and autumn shoreline remain static.

ash_foundry.review: Cooling basins between forested banks. Conservative interior patches avoid conifers, pylons and refinery buildings.

abandoned_harbor.review: Large shipping channel and near water. Rocks, west pier posts, ship and warehouse silhouettes are excluded.

basalt_quarry.review: Quiet quarry pools on the right; avoid basalt terraces, rock islands and foreground trees.

overgrown_steelworks.review: Shallow marsh channels between reeds, wooded banks and concrete ruins; conservative masks do not sway the trees.

frozen_rail_yard.review: No reliable exposed water or ice. Visible white areas are snow over tracks, ballast, trees and rocks; keep static.

iron_canyon.review: Dry rock, scrub and dust; no visually justified water or exposed ice target.

flooded_power_station.review: Broad reservoir, five local spillway/outlet streams. Reeds, island plants, concrete supports and gates stay static.

mountain_pass.review: Small meandering river glimpses in the valley; the viaduct, cliff faces and conifers stay static.

storm_dam.review: Turbulent tailwater plus six independently masked falls. Dam wall, buttresses, power buildings, rocks and pines remain static.

sulfur_refinery.review: Shallow reflective yellow-green chemical ponds, not the yellow rock banks; very subdued liquid motion.

radar_highlands.review: Two conservative smooth blue frozen-basin patches. Static ice with faint glint only; surrounding snow is excluded and no liquid displacement is permitted.

buried_megafactory.review: Dry red ruins, rubble, machines and terrain; no visually justified water or ice target.
